title: Stamp each stored off-file leftover (each matrix draft, stored document original and Lp(a) kept answer) with the erase it was written under, so a clear removes only what is older than the record's erase
evidence: Root fix R4 (triage 2026-11-25), design docs/drafts/r4-leftover-stamps-design.md, split in four PRs. Done, PR 1 (US-11 AC12): the page's clear after an erase (roadmap-data.ts clearOffFileAfterErase, the store's clearOffFileData) goes through the session's tryClear, which reports a failed clear once per erase in a session; the store's own report is deleted. Test: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.erase-event-pins.test.tsx (US-11 AC12). In review, PR 2 (test-only, PR 2182): widget-src/src/storage/off-file-clear-pins.test.tsx pins what each clear must still remove, each leftover written by its own writer: a draft typed before an erase in any tab, a lagging tab's included (US-11 AC1, AC6); every Lp(a) answer kept before it (US-05 AC3); every stored original the erase did not keep, one uploaded after it staying readable (US-09 AC20, AC23); everything at log-off, leftovers newer than the latest erase included (US-09 AC2d). All pass on main. Left: PR 3, each leftover (matrix draft, stored original, Lp(a) kept answer) stored with the erase it was written under, a clear removing only older ones, legacy entries stamped at open, and the pin at packages/health-core/src/record-session.clear-owed.test.ts:485-486 flipped; PR 4, the per-browser key machinery deleted (lib/cleared-erase.ts, clearOwed, clearedFor, RecordHost.clearedErase and noteCleared). PRs 3 and 4 wait for the erase-by-type series (R5).
